_README: EDITABLE SOURCE for the decision-flow canvas. Edit here, then run `python3 build_canvas.py` to regenerate decision_flow.canvas. These tables come from Kristen's 06/25/26 feedback (the .xlsx files) and are NOT yet in the engine JSON. Engine numeric thresholds are NOT duplicated here — the canvas reads those straight from ../aim2_engine/data/titration_thresholds.json so they can't drift from the engine.

no_seizures_footnotes:
* Uneven dosing OK for: clobazam, valproic acid, carbamazepine, oxcarbazepine — within 30/70 to 40/60, easiest dose form.

† Labs by drug: VPA→CBC/CMP/LFTs/ammonia/level • CBZ→CBC/CMP/LFTs/level • OXC→CBC/CMP/LFTs/level • TPM→CBC/CMP/level • ZNS→CBC/CMP/level • ESM→level
urgency_table: E. Acting off / not responding (focal impaired)

family_choice.question:
Still having seizures AND already some side effects.
“You know your child best.”
Open to increasing dose (side effects may worsen)?
family_choice.yes:
YES — side effects manageable
→ Option: INCREASE current dose
(may improve control; watch side effects)
family_choice.no:
NO — feels like max dose
→ Option: ADD a second medication
(complementary mechanisms; lower each dose)
family_choice.shared:
Either path is valid — physician reviews the DRAFT.
Recommendation never reaches family without sign-off.
